title: Part 1
summary: A short explination of my experiences implementing Part 1
content: Part 1 features a theme switcher (light mode to dark mode and vice versa), that has a persistent preference. This means that the theme must stay what it was left when the page is reloaded. I approached this part by creating the switch that when clicked on would trigger the theme switch. I then completed the JavaScript provided by the assignment to provide a function to the switch. I put the switch in the header part of the webpage as I felt as though that would make it clear for a user to find and access. A difficulty that I encountered with this part was placing the words “Theme Switch” next to the switch, however after trial and error I was able to have the switch and words close together, making it clear to the user what the switch does.
